title: [교외행사] Job Information for Foreign Students in Korea
contentHtml:
Job Information for Foreign Students in Korea

 

 

Global Top Tier PM/CM Company ‘HanmiGlobal’

 

 

Since its foundation through a strategic alliance with Parsons (a global EC & CM

 

company) on June 18th 1996, HanmiGlobal introduced Project Management (PM) in

 

Korea and transformed the way of delivering construction projects to clients from

 

inception to completion and beyond. We have also been at the forefront of

 

improving recognition of the Korean construction industry by leveraging our

 

expertise and empowering our employees to provide differentiated solutions.

 

In addition, we have entered the global construction market, upholding the

 

reputation of Korean construction firms and striving to become the leading global

 

company.

 

 

HanmiGlobal will progress further to being a global PM company

 

In order to realize the vision of being a global PM company, HanmiGlobal will

 

consider customer value creation as top priority while striving for outstanding

 

results. HanmiGlobal will also further enhance technical competencies to solve the

 

world’s complex challenges, and also cultivate the core capabilities as a ‘Total

 

Solution Provider’

 

 

Job Information

 

 

1. Qualification

 

- Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree (Graduated or Expected to graduate before Aug 2020)

 

- Applicants with no reasons for disqualification in acquiring working visa (E-7) in

 

Korea

 

- Fluent in written and spoken English

 

 

 

 

2. Job Description

 

Role : Project Management (PM/CM Service)

 

 

· Provide overall project management and administration of design, constructions

 

and commissioning services for client

 

 

· Confirm that appropriate project authorization and funding is in place before

 

activities begin

 

· Prepare cash flow projections and monitors financial performance

 

 

· Assures that al necessary jurisdictional approvals are obtained and that all

 

applicable codes and standards are met

 

 

· Assist in proactive schedule management of all major project milestones

 

 

· Diligently pursue the timely completion of any punch list and all project

 

closeout activities

 

 

 

 

3. Minimum Requirements

 

BS in Architecture, Civil, Mechanical, Electric, Electronics Engineering, CM or

 

related Degree

 

 

4. Preferred Qualification

 

· Fluent in written and spoken Korean.

 

· Test of Proficiency in Korea Score Holders

 

· Other foreign languages certifications

 

· Internship or work experiences in the related fields of EPC, Construction,

 

PM/CM industries

 

· Professional registration, LEED accreditation

 

 

5. What We Offer

 

· According to HR Policy, We will provide all salary and benefit on a par

 

with Korean employees with bachelor or master degree.

 

· When you join HanmiGlobal, you become part of member in head office that is

 

pioneering the future.

 

· We will consider to provide opportunity for you when company enter new

 

country markets included country.

 

 

6. Working Type &　Location

 

· Working Type : Full Time (Contract)

 

· Location : Korea or Overseas office

 

 

7. How to apply

 

1) Visit the e-link (http://www.hanmiglobal.com/en/about/recruit.asp)

 

2) Fill out the form (Basic Information) as detailed as possible

 

3) Choose ’Project Management’ in Job category menu and ’Korea’ in Country.

 

3) Attach your resume and CVs. (If it is impossible, please send us your

 

documents as below (recruit@hanmiglobal.com)

 

4) Please click button ’Apply’

 

 

8. Q&A : Talent Acquisition Manager (recruit@hanmiglobal.com)

 

 

9. Closing Date :　June 8th 2020
